mainScript.description: Main Legend Mod client script containing core game rendering, networking, settings and UI.

modules.description: Synchronises theme settings between game CSS variables and the settings panel. Handles --lm-radius, --lm-pc2, --lm-tc2, --lm-mc variables.
Accessibility features: menu text scale (Settings > Accessibility) and HUD text scale (Theme > HUD, on top of the HUD scale); reduced motion is a core option.

Game stats for the Replays window: the Dashboard, Heatmaps, Coach (play pattern analysis) and Objectives (daily ones scaled to your own game history for long sessions, and personal) views, from the summaries of every game (always recorded). Tracks position samples, splits, kills.
Death recap showing last 20 seconds of life as 3-6 summarised steps with mass sparkline. 128-sample ring buffer, 64-event ring buffer.

Full gamepad/controller support: the 16 buttons are bound in the Hotkeys window like keys; dead zone, response curve, triggers, inverted axes and vibration in the Gamepad window (modules/gamepad-ui.js, with a live test).
Split range circles, merge sound, relative mass, edge arrows, move direction arrow, mass format modes, virus range circles.
Drag and resize HUD elements with named layouts. Up to 20 saved layouts, grid snapping (8/16/32px).
Notification centre with bell icon, unread count, 8 categories, 4 types. Up to 200 notifications, 120KB storage limit.
Full replay playback with timeline, bookmarks, variable speed (0.25x-4x), backward seeking, packet-by-packet stepping.
Offline practice mode against bots using MultiOgar protocol. Personal bests, ghost replay, deterministic physics (mulberry32 RNG).
Spectator Director: auto-camera following action, watchlist (20), map bookmarks (20), cinematic camera, broadcast HUD, leaderboard history.
User scripts/plugins system. 5 slots, LMPlugins API with settings registration, version compatibility checking.
Experimental features toggle. Modules and plugins register experiments with on/off switches stored separately from settings; plugins.js shows them in the User Scripts window.
Feature guide cards introducing Legend Mod features. One-tap option switches; never opens by itself (scripts: LMDiscovery.open()).
Collection of small utility tools: sound mixer, minimap features, leaderboard features, various UI helpers.
Theme creation and management window (Theme tab button): up to 30 themes with 5 versions each, live preview, Compare, gallery.
Hotkey command system with 146+ unique hotkey bindings. Toggle hotkeys, zoom levels, chat commands, bot controls.
Chrome extension bridge script. Handles extension-to-page communication, theme queries and hashing.
